comparison.objective: Manipulate a faucet to diagnose its hidden fault and file the matching report.
comparison.physical_skill: Active mechanical testing followed by diagnosis tagging.
comparison.success_condition: Correct tag for normal, will-not-open, or will-not-shut mode; wrong diagnosis receives 0.3.
comparison.reason: Although it verifies mechanism behavior, it diagnoses discrete faults rather than adjusting and locking a stop.
